fault_notes: The customer's broadband has been down for three days, leaving her unable to work from home reliably. Although Chloe repeatedly explains the stress and practical consequences of the outage, the agent consistently ignores her emotional concerns and responds only with procedural or technical statements. [On saving: noconfirm added, the call ends with an engineer booked and the fault not fixed. Agent sentiment removed. Customer scores run only -2 to -9, so no line reaches the -15 upset bar on score alone.]

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net. You're speaking with Daniel. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi, Chloe Williams. My broadband's been completely down for three days now, and I work from home, so I'm really struggling.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can check the broadband service for you. Could you provide your account number, please?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it's 704193628. Honestly, I'm falling behind with work because I can't connect to anything.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Before I access the account, can you confirm the first line of your registered address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's 18 Meadow Close, Leeds. This has been a nightmare all week.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Chloe. I've verified the account. I'll start by checking the service status for your address.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. I just need it working again. I've had to use my phone's data for meetings, and that's nearly gone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The account shows an active broadband package. I'm checking whether there are any network incidents recorded in your area.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: There was a brief outage on Monday, but it never came back for me. I've restarted everything so many times.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll need to check the line status and then run through the router indicators with you.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right, but I'm honestly getting worried. My manager's already asked why I've missed two online meetings.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The service checker is loading now. It may take a few seconds to retrieve the line information.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Fine. I just need some idea of when it'll be fixed because I can't keep working like this.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The checker isn't showing a confirmed area-wide outage at the moment. Let's look at the equipment in your home.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The router's on. The internet light is orange, and the broadband light keeps flashing. The Wi-Fi name appears, but nothing connects.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: An orange internet light can indicate that the router isn't establishing a connection. Is the broadband cable firmly connected at both ends?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I've checked it. I've unplugged it and put it back in. I even tried a different socket.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: All right. Please switch the router off using the power button, wait thirty seconds, and turn it back on.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I've done that every day since Monday. But okay, I'll do it again while we're on the phone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Once it powers back on, the lights may take two or three minutes to settle.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's restarting now. I'm supposed to present something this afternoon, and I don't know how I'm going to do it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The router needs a little time to reconnect. Please leave it switched on while the lights settle.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The Wi-Fi light's back, but the broadband light is still flashing. The internet light is orange again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That suggests the wireless network is available locally, but the router still hasn't established its broadband connection.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Exactly, and that's why I'm calling. I've already explained it's been three days, and I really can't afford another day without it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll run a remote diagnostic to check whether the line is responding. This can take around a minute.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. Please tell me if there's something wrong outside or if it's something in my house.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The diagnostic is running. I'm checking the connection between the local exchange and your router.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm sorry if I'm going on about it. I'm just stressed because my job depends on having a connection.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The diagnostic is still processing. I'll wait for the result before deciding on the next step.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I understand. I just wish someone could give me a straight answer. I've been checking it constantly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The result shows that the router isn't responding to the broadband connection test. I'll check the line profile next.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So does that mean the router's broken? I don't want to spend money replacing something if that's not the problem.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not necessarily. The line profile can help determine whether the issue is with the network or the equipment.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right. I'm getting really anxious about this because I don't have another way to get online at home.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The profile check is complete. It indicates that the line may not be synchronising correctly, so I'll run one further test.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you tell me whether this is something that can be fixed remotely? I need to plan what to do tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The next test will check whether the connection can be restored remotely. I'll submit it now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. I've been using the library for meetings, but I can't keep leaving the house just to do my job.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The remote test has completed. It hasn't restored the connection, so the next option is to arrange a line investigation.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: A line investigation? How long does that take? I'm already three days into this, and I can't keep telling work I have no internet.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The investigation can involve a remote network check or a visit from an engineer, depending on the results.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I need the earliest possible appointment. I've got deadlines coming up, and this is affecting my income.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll check the available engineer appointments for your postcode. The booking system is loading.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please check the earliest one. I'm honestly at the point where I don't know what else to do.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The earliest appointment currently available is Thursday between eight in the morning and midday.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thursday? That's another two days away. I can't believe I've got to wait that long when the service has already been down for three days.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is the earliest standard appointment showing in the system. I can add the case to the cancellation list.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, please. I'm really worried that I'm going to get into trouble at work if this continues.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I've added the cancellation-list request. It doesn't guarantee an earlier slot, but you'll be contacted if one becomes available.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is there anything else you can do? Even a temporary connection would help. I can't use mobile data indefinitely.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can check whether your account includes a temporary mobile data allowance while the broadband fault is being investigated.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That would be useful. My phone's nearly out of data, and I have a video call tomorrow morning.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your package doesn't include an automatic data backup benefit. I can explain the available mobile add-ons, which would be chargeable.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I don't really want to pay extra because the broadband isn't working. I've already paid for a service I haven't been able to use.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can provide the details of the available add-ons, but I can't apply a free allowance through this account screen.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All right. Could you at least make sure the engineer knows it's been down since Monday and that I work from home?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I've added a note that the broadband service is down and that you require the connection for home working.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you. I just feel like I'm repeating myself and nothing's changing. Three days is a long time to be without internet.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The case notes now include the outage duration and the home-working requirement. Your engineer appointment remains booked for Thursday morning.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. Will I get a text message confirming the appointment, or do I need to keep checking my account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: A confirmation message will be sent to the mobile number registered on your account. It should include the appointment window.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Fine. I'm still not sure how I'm supposed to manage tomorrow, but at least there's an appointment arranged.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The appointment is booked for Thursday between eight and midday, and the cancellation-list request is active.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All right. I suppose I'll have to make other arrangements for work until then.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your case reference is SN-583104. You can quote that number if you contact us again about this fault.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I've got that written down. I just hope it gets sorted because this has caused a lot of disruption.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The next step is the engineer investigation on Thursday. Is there anything else on the account you'd like me to check?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that's everything. I just wish there had been a clearer answer sooner.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The case is logged, the appointment is booked, and the cancellation-list request has been recorded. Thank you for choosing S-Net.
